speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry (a) whether the Ministry tracks the amount of expenditure made by Singapore residents at overseas e-commerce platforms; (b) if so, what is the trend and percentage of the total expenditure by Singapore residents on these overseas e-commerce platforms as compared to purchases made offline locally; and (c) what measures have been taken to support local businesses in the competition against these overseas e-commerce platforms.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: This only includes sales done through retailers registered with the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA).

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: The retail industry has changed significantly with digitalisation and the growth of e-commerce platforms.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: With the shift to online retail, our enterprises can leverage on e-commerce platforms to access new customers locally and overseas.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: We have implemented a range of initiatives to help our businesses adapt and compete.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: With the help of e-commerce solution providers, we also support enterprises in selling their products on multiple overseas e-marketplaces, so that they can expand their customer base.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: In the global marketplace, it becomes even more important for businesses to differentiate their products and position themselves to serve customers better.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: The Government will continue to work with enterprises to adapt and innovate for greater e-commerce potential.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: We have finished up all the Parliamentary Questions for Oral Answer.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: I propose to take an extended break now.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: I suspend the Sitting and will take the Chair at 3.30 pm.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Sitting accordingly suspended  at 2.40 pm until 3.30 pm.
